_comment: Digital Confidence Centre — White-Label Branding Template
_instructions: Fill in all fields below and send to [Two Birds contact — see private vault]. Fields marked REQUIRED must be provided before deployment can begin.

organisation.name: REQUIRED — Your full organisation name (e.g. Elgin County Library)
organisation.shortName: REQUIRED — Short display name (e.g. ECL Digital Learning)
organisation.tagline: Optional — One-line tagline shown under your name
organisation.type: library | credit_union | bank | senior_centre | health_unit | other
organisation.contactEmail: REQUIRED — Primary contact email for this deployment
organisation.contactPhone: Optional — Phone number for learner support
organisation.city: REQUIRED — Primary city served (e.g. St. Thomas)

branding.primaryColour: REQUIRED — Hex code (e.g. #1565C0). This replaces DCC blue.
branding.logoUrl: REQUIRED — URL or file path to your logo (SVG preferred, min 200px wide)
branding.logoAltText: REQUIRED — Alt text for your logo (e.g. Elgin County Library logo)
branding.favicon: Optional — URL to favicon (32x32 PNG or ICO)
branding.fontFamily: Optional — Google Fonts name or 'default' to keep existing

domain.subdomain: Optional — e.g. seniors (becomes seniors.twobirds.ca if no custom domain)

content.siteName: REQUIRED — Name shown in browser tab and header (e.g. ECL Digital Learning Centre)
content.welcomeMessage: Optional — Custom welcome message on the home page
content.localPhoneNumber: Optional — Local helpline to show instead of Connected Canadians
content.localPhoneLabel: Optional — Label for local phone (e.g. ECL Tech Help Line)
content.hideModules: Optional — Array of module numbers to hide (e.g. [10, 11])
content.customResourcesCity: Optional — Default city for local resources lookup (e.g. Stratford)
content.footerText: Optional — Custom footer line (e.g. Presented by Elgin County Library)

analytics.googleAnalyticsId: Optional — Your own GA4 measurement ID (e.g. G-XXXXXXXXXX)
analytics._note: DCC retains aggregate analytics. Set shareAnalyticsWithDCC to false for Enterprise tier.
